entities.title: Family Reunion Visa Application
entities.summary: Family reunion visas allow family members to join relatives in Germany, with applications submitted at the Consulate General in Karachi or, from 15.01.2026, via the Consular Services Portal at the German Embassy in Islamabad. Extensive documentation is required, including proof of relationship, language certificates, and payment of visa fees.
eligibility: to apply for a spouse visa, both partners have to be at least 18 years old

A1 language certificate required unless exempt categories apply (e.g. spouses of recognized refugees married before partner left Pakistan, spouses of EU Blue Card/ICT Card holders, spouses of non-German EU nationals, parents of minor German children)

C1 language certificate required for applicants 16 or 17 years of age, with exemptions for those moving with both parents, children of recognized refugees, children of certain residence title holders, children of non-German EU nationals
required_documents: Application form (Videx application)
One biometric passport photo of each applicant and reference person in Germany (no older than 3 months)
Certificate of residency in Germany (Meldebescheinigung) of spouse/family member (no older than 6 months)
Copy of spouse's/family member's residence permit
Applicant's current passport and ID card (CNIC)
Copies of previous passports
Copies of spouse's/family member's valid and previous passports
Original NADRA computerized birth certificate
Original Nikah Nama (in Urdu with English translation)
Original NADRA computerized marriage registration certificate
Proof of previous marriages for both spouses if applicable
Court order regarding legal guardianship if applicable
BAMF deed if applicable
Travel insurance policy valid for one year from date of application
A1 language certificate (with exemptions)
C1 language certificate (with exemptions, for applicants 16-17)
Additional proof of name, birthday and relationship as a family
Appointment confirmation e-mail (Islamabad applicants)
Applicant's declaration
Information regarding legal representation
Visa fees
application_process: Register with the Pakistan Visa Section at the German Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate General in Karachi depending on residence/citizenship
For Islamabad: submit application via the Consular Services Portal (www.digital.diplo.de) starting 15.01.2026
Embassy reviews application; if in order, applicant receives link to book appointment
At appointment: show original documents, pay application fee, submit biometrics
Diplomatic mission may request additional documents or PKR 75,000 for document verification
For Karachi: present original documents including passport at time of application; passport remains at mission during processing
entities.application_fee: 75 Euros (payable in PKR) for adults; 37.50 Euros (payable in PKR) for children aged 0-17; no fee if joining a German or EU national
important_notes: Registering on waitlist for family reunion or marriage visa is not a timely notice (fristwahrende Anzeige) under Section 29(2)1 of the Residence Act for family members of recognised refugees
Family member in Germany must submit timely notice within 3 months of being recognised as a refugee to benefit from simplified visa process
Applicants joining an EU citizen (not German) must still register with Pakistan Visa Section at German Embassy Islamabad and indicate family reunion to EU citizen for expedited appointment
Additional documents required for marrying in Germany or joining an EU citizen
Recommended to obtain up-to-date documents only once appointment is confirmed due to long waiting times
entities.min_language_score: A1 (or C1 for applicants aged 16-17, with exemptions)
